title: EXP-07 C11 Residual Error and Epistemic Audit Register

residual_errors_identified.finding: C11 report prose and incident records referenced 'Class 6 (OF)'. In the authoritative dense mapping (exp07_reference.py), OF (Ocean Front) is Dense Index 5. Dense Index 6 is POW (Pure Ocean Wave).
residual_errors_identified.root_cause: Conflation between Source Label ID (where OF is Source 6) and Dense Class Index (where OF is Dense 5, due to exclusion of Source Label 3 Iceberg).
residual_errors_identified.correction: Explicitly distinguish between 'Source Label ID' and 'Dense Class Index'. When discussing model output channels or dense evaluation, OF is Dense Index 5 and POW is Dense Index 6.

residual_errors_identified.finding: C11 report prose stated that Sentinel-1 'measures normalized radar backscatter cross-section (sigma0)'.
residual_errors_identified.root_cause: Conflation between physical radar interaction, standard radiometrically calibrated products, and the actual uncalibrated EXP-07 runtime representation.

distinction_established.physical_sensor: Sentinel-1 spaceborne C-band (5.405 GHz) microwave Synthetic Aperture Radar measuring backscattered electromagnetic pulses.
distinction_established.product_quantity: Level-1 Ground Range Detected (GRD) amplitude/intensity digital numbers (DN). Radiometric calibration to sigma0 requires external Look-Up Tables (LUTs).
distinction_established.runtime_input: Uncalibrated 10x10 spatially aggregated raw digital numbers (DN), transformed via log1p, and standardized by TRAIN statistics (mean=0.5518, std=0.3121).

residual_errors_identified.correction: Prohibit stating that EXP-07 operates on sigma0. The runtime input is an uncalibrated 'SAR-derived detected DN-domain representation'.

residual_errors_identified.finding: C11 eliminated major causal overclaims ('proven', 'confirmed'), but occasionally used shorthand such as 'parent scarcity caused failure'.
residual_errors_identified.root_cause: Colloquial prose drift in analytical summary sections.
residual_errors_identified.correction: Enforce strict associational language: 'failure is associated with limited independent parent-scene representation'. Hypotheses without interventional ablation isolation remain SUPPORTED or PLAUSIBLE, never CAUSAL ESTABLISHED.

residual_errors_identified.finding: C11 referred to HM as Class 11, which is correct in Dense Index space (Dense 11), but Source Label ID is 13.
residual_errors_identified.root_cause: Failure to annotate the index space when reporting class numbers.
residual_errors_identified.correction: Always specify index space: 'HM (Dense Class 11 / Source Label 13)'.

verified_sound_conclusions.parameter_count: 14,310,860 trainable parameters / 14,322,666 state elements across 192 tensors strictly verified.
verified_sound_conclusions.protocol_equivalence: Seed 101 was a protocol-identical replicate of Seed 42 with zero protocol drift.
verified_sound_conclusions.eddy_bs_confusion: Eddy cannibalization of 63.75% of BS pixels in Seed 101 disproved the reciprocal BS<->LWA swapping narrative.
verified_sound_conclusions.scene01_collapse: Scene 01 collapse is an empirical parent-specific representation collapse reproduced across both seeds.
verified_sound_conclusions.two_seed_limits: Two seeds provide empirical range [0.11903, 0.13782], not a population distribution.
verified_sound_conclusions.dataset_sufficiency: OPS-01 is an initial exploratory benchmark, structurally insufficient for operational deployment.
